name: Weererwirt
beschreibung:
History

The website weererwirt.at describes the house as a historic inn from 1312 in Weer and at the same time as „neo-wirtshaus“ and „Wirtshaus neu gedacht“. The year 1312 stands as such in the image description on the page. An independent document is not linked there, so the year remains a statement by the business. The kitchen text describes a path from gourmet and Haubenküche back to this stove and a concept that combines compositions shaped by Haubenküche with a light atmosphere. A list of earlier innkeepers or a building description beyond this self-description is not on the page retrieved. The page names the place as Weer, Dorfstraße 5, 6116 Weer. The older claim that the house lies not far from Kufstein does not appear there.

Getting there

The published address is Dorfstraße 5, 6116 Weer. Telephone 05224 6114, email office@weererwirt.at. A description of train, bus or parking spaces is not on the homepage retrieved. Opening hours according to the same page: Monday and Tuesday 11:30 to 14:30, Wednesday and Thursday 11:30 to 14:30 and 16:00 to 22:00, Friday and Saturday 11:30 to 22:00. Sunday is absent from this list.

Tips

The course of the day on the page: at midday clear menus, in the afternoon an aperitif with appetiser bites, in the evening Casual Fine Dining à la carte or a tasting menu. From January, on Thursdays in the bar area and in the vault, a „Genussreise“ with small dishes from around the world for sharing is announced. The house also offers tastings, weddings and other formats. As regional partners the page names Black Angus and Wagyu from Tierol in Gnadenwald, the Bio-Metzgerei Juffinger in Thiersee, the Quellfischzucht Schwaz, eggs from Thomas Egger in Schwaz, Micro Greens from Bergblatt in Innsbruck, the Brennerei Rochelt in Fritzens and Zimmermann Obst- und Weinbau in Fritzens. As a partner outside the region, Frantoio Montecroce in Desenzano del Garda is listed for olive oil and wine. An example dish on the page is the duet of pre-rigor salmon with koji-fermented salmon, tartare of house-cured salmon, confit fennel, mango gel and puffed rice paper for 17 euros. On sustainability the house writes of short distances, selected partners and the avoidance of waste, up to compostable packaging.

Important for this accommodation page: the current website describes the kitchen, opening hours and events. Guest rooms, bed numbers or overnight prices are not published there. Older entries that list the Weererwirt as a hotel with rooms cannot be substantiated with the page retrieved and are not continued here.
kurzbeschreibung: Inn at Dorfstraße 5 in Weer, which describes itself as a historic house from 1312 and as a newly conceived Haubenküche. The current page does not publish guest rooms.
